name: shared-browser
description: Share a Chromium browser with your coding agent inside VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Starts a local browser and desktop processes.

browserView.allowNoSandbox.description: Explicitly allow Chromium without its sandbox for an isolated root container. Prefer a non-root Linux host with a working sandbox.

browserView.quality.description: Display JPEG quality (0–9). Lower values reduce traffic.

browserView.compression.description: Display compression (0–9). Higher values use more CPU.

browserView.webPort.description: Loopback viewer port. Stop and reopen the browser to apply; the profile is retained.

browserView.cdpPort.description: Private loopback agent control port. Never expose publicly. Stop and reopen the browser to apply; the profile is retained.

browserView.display.description: Dedicated X display number. Stop and reopen the browser to apply; the profile is retained.

browserView.desktopWidth.description: Shared desktop width in pixels. Viewer resizing does not change it. Stop and reopen the browser to apply; the profile is retained.

browserView.desktopHeight.description: Shared desktop height in pixels. Stop and reopen the browser to apply; the profile is retained.

browserView.stateDirectory.description: Absolute path to private session state, or ~/path. Empty uses ~/.local/share/browser-view. Stop the current browser before changing this setting.

browserView.chromiumPath.description: Path to the Chromium/Chrome executable. Empty discovers a system or Playwright browser. Stop the current browser before changing this setting.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
